item.title: CmdPal: Bookmark {placeholder} field retains last-entered value on every subsequent open
item.author: tbertran

judgment.rationale: The report includes a source-level root cause and an independent UI automation reproduction showing the placeholder value persists only within the current Command Palette session.
evidence: BookmarkListItem creates BookmarkPlaceholderPage once during classification.
BookmarkPlaceholderPage stores StringParameterRun instances and LaunchWithCurrentValues dismisses without clearing them.
External automation shows second open pre-fills the previous value while restart resets it.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a small Command Palette bookmark fix clearing placeholder values after successful launch plus focused test coverage.

fix_assessment.rationale: No upstream fix attempt was found and the source/repro evidence is direct.

proposed_fixes.title: Reset bookmark placeholder parameters after launch
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Cached BookmarkPlaceholderPage/StringParameterRun objects retain the last Text value for the next invocation.
plan: Add ResetPlaceholderValues clearing all StringParameterRun.Text values and updating subtitle.
Call reset only after CommandLauncher.Launch succeeds.
Add a repeated-open placeholder bookmark test.
verification: Launch placeholder bookmark with value 1, reopen same session, confirm field is empty.
Confirm failed launch keeps values while page remains open.

confidence.rationale: Source, issue analysis, and automation all point to cached StringParameterRun state.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette bookmark placeholders remember the last value typed in the current session and pre-fill it on later opens.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 / Command Palette 0.12.12365 reproduces on x64 and ARM64 external automation.
Value does not persist after restart.
Issue has Product-Command Palette and Issue-Bug labels.
inferences: Clearing runs after successful launch should restore empty per-open fields without touching saved bookmarks.
issue_context.analysis: The cached command owns the parameter runs, so the UI reflects stale in-memory Text.
initial_investigation: Checked origin/main BookmarkListItem.cs and BookmarkPlaceholderPage.cs at 5abd20e355998a865075a06676bebfc1d9925be4.
Searched public PRs for BookmarkPlaceholderPage/StringParameterRun; no fix PR surfaced.

design.root_cause: StringParameterRun.Text is not reset after successful placeholder launch.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Successful launch dismisses but leaves Text values.
implementation_steps.change: After success, clear all placeholder run Text values and update subtitle.
implementation_steps.code_block: if (success) { foreach (run in _placeholderRuns.Values) run.Text = string.Empty; UpdateSubtitle(); return Dismiss(); } return KeepOpen();
edge_cases: Repeated placeholder names share one run.

verify: Run Command Palette bookmark tests and manual placeholder repro.
risks: Only transient UI state changes; persisted bookmarks untouched.
alternatives: Rebuilding page every open rejected as heavier than reset.
